governance.stableSecurity: Standard — Stable Release Security Blockers v1.0

finalStableRequirements: Select the exact merged release-preparation revision after authoritative branch protection and dependency/supply-chain security are verified.
Build the final non-publishing candidate runtime/source artifact from that exact revision through a controlled release-preparation workflow.
Record exact source commit and tree identity.
Record the intended immutable version/tag/release identity without creating or publishing it before final security acceptance.
Record artifact name, size, SHA-256 checksum, and supported distribution boundary.
Retain an applicable CycloneDX SBOM covering the released runtime/source boundary and separately accepted build/supply-chain evidence.
Retain provenance tying the exact artifact bytes to the exact approved source revision and controlled build workflow.
Retain signing or attestation evidence when required by the final release workflow or governance.
Complete final Stable security acceptance for the same exact source revision and artifact bytes before publication.
Retain rollback binding to GLAZE UI 1.5.1.
Only after release preparation and final Stable security acceptance pass, create the immutable tag/release and publish only the accepted artifact.
After publication, read back the immutable tag/release/artifact identity and verify it matches the approved revision and evidence.
Update lifecycle, release, documentation, task, and consumer-target records only after the authoritative publication state is verified.
unresolvedPrerequisites: Protected merge of the final-artifact preparation implementation and selection of the exact resulting main revision.
Successful exact-main final-artifact preparation workflow run producing deterministic candidate artifact, checksum, SBOM, provenance, and clean extracted-artifact secret scan.
Final Stable release-security acceptance for the same exact source revision and artifact bytes before publication.
Controlled immutable v1.6.0 publication reusing the accepted artifact bytes and authoritative post-publication readback.
Final exact-candidate Stable qualification review after publication readback.
boundary: Authoritative main protection and dependency/supply-chain security are verified. The final non-publishing 1.6.0 artifact preparation workflow is implemented on this candidate branch but is not yet authoritative until governed merge. After merge, its exact main revision must produce deterministic artifact bytes, checksum/SBOM/provenance, and a clean extracted-artifact secret scan before final Stable security acceptance. Publication, Stable lifecycle, and consumer eligibility remain unauthorized.

finalizationSequence.requirement: Authoritative main protection is verified through active ruleset 23699829 with no bypass and strict required checks.
Merge the final-artifact preparation implementation through protected main and select that exact resulting main revision; any later release-boundary source change creates a new candidate.

Run the final-artifact preparation workflow on the exact selected main revision; require deterministic double-build equality, SHA-256 manifest, CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM, provenance, archive-boundary validation, and extracted-artifact secret scan.
Complete final Stable security acceptance against the exact protected source revision and the exact unpublished candidate artifact bytes.
Create the controlled immutable v1.6.0 release identity and publish only the artifact bytes already accepted by final security review; do not rebuild for publication.
Read back the published tag, release, artifact, checksum, SBOM, and provenance and verify they resolve to the accepted source revision and bytes.
Run the final exact-candidate Stable qualification review and only then reconcile Stable lifecycle and consumer-eligibility records.
